title: release-cutover-checklist-2026-03-18-harper-scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - release cutover (2026-03-18)
Owner: Harper Nguyen
Co-owners: Riley Park, Samira Khan
Context: Hotfix + minor feature rollout to prod. Planned cutover window 09:30-10:30 PT.

GOALS
- Deploy release v2026.03.18-hotfix (serving runtime + config)
- Ensure zero-regressions on critical customer flows (chat generation, embeddings)
- Backports applied for REL-2026, REL-2027
- Clear comms to SRE/Sales/Support during and post-cutover

PRE-CUTOVER (done before 09:30)
- [x] Finalize release notes & changelog (PR merged) - Samira
- [x] Verify smoke tests pass on staging (smoke-suite/staging) - Riley
- [x] Confirm reserved Dedicated pool capacity for rollout (infra ticket) - Check with Priya
- [x] Create incident channel #inc-rel-2026-03-18 (on-call added) - Harper
- [x] Post pre-cutover message to #releases and #sre with window + rollback plan - Harper
- [ ] Ensure DB migrations are non-blocking (double-check migration REL-2026-mig) - TODO: review with DB team
- [ ] Final traffic routing config (canary %) decided (default -> 10% canary first 15m) - decision pending

DURING CUTOVER (09:30 - 10:30)
- 09:30: Start canary deploy to 10% traffic (region: us-west1) - Riley (deploy runbook step 2)
- 09:35: Run quick smoke on canary (2 requests: chat gen + embed) - Harper
- 09:40: Check observability: latency, error rate, token cost metrics - Samira
- 09:45: If errors <1% and latency stable, proceed to 50% ramp - Riley
- 09:55: Monitor for model fallback events and KV cache pressure (logs + traces) - Harper
- 10:10: If stable, complete rollout to 100% (or schedule second ramp if anomalies) - decision call on #inc-rel-2026-03-18
- 10:25: Run post-rollout e2e smoke (customer-flow-sanity) - Samira
- 10:30: Close cutover window, update #releases and CS w/ summary - Harper

POST-CUTOVER VERIFICATION
- [ ] Confirm SLAs (p99 latency) within SLOs for last 30m - observability team
- [ ] Spot-check costs (token/unit increase) vs expected - finance tag
- [ ] Validate canary logs vs prod for any unexpected warnings (kv-cache thrash) - Riley
- [ ] Open follow-up tickets for anything degraded (link here)

BACKPORTS / HOTFIXES
- REL-2026: backport fix for attention-kernel bug -> PR #4187 (needs cherry-pick to release branch) - assigned to Samira
- REL-2027: minor config tweak for batching defaults -> PR #4199 (post-cutover validation) - Harper
- Notes: prioritize REL-2026; if cannot backport cleanly, prepare rollback plan (see below)

COMMS
- Pre-cutover: posted 08:45 PT in #releases + email to eng-leads
- During: updates every 15m in #inc-rel-2026-03-18 (Riley)
- Post: summary + links to CI, metrics, and any follow-ups - Harper to draft
- CS/Support: ping support@redwood with expected user impact (none expected) and contact list

ROLLBACK PLAN (if >2% errors or major regressions)
- Trigger: sustained error rate >2% for 10 minutes OR latency p99 spikes >2x baseline
- Steps:
  1) Pause new rollouts and move traffic back to previous variant (deploy rollback script) - Riley
  2) Re-open incident channel and notify stakeholders - Harper
  3) Re-run smoke tests on previous variant, confirm baseline restored - Samira
  4) Create postmortem and schedule fix-backport sprint

OPEN/UNRESOLVED
- DB migration: need sign-off from DB team on no downtime (ticket DB-309) - blocker until 09:00 PT
- Canary ramp %: propose 10% -> 50% -> 100% but want SRE thumbs-up
- Observability alert thresholds: confirm if we should temporarily loosen token-cost alerts during rollout

QUICK COMMANDS / LINKS
- Deploy runbook: github.com/redwood/runbooks/deploy-cutover.md
- Smoke tests: ci.redwood/smoke-suite (staging + prod)
- Metrics dashboard: dashboards.redwood/release/REL-2026
- Incident channel: slack:#inc-rel-2026-03-18

PERSONAL TODO (today)
- 08:00-09:00: finalize checklist + confirm DB sign-off
- 09:20: post reminder in #releases
- 09:30-10:30: be on-call for cutover; take notes for postmortem
- 11:00: draft post-cutover summary

Notes to self: keep check-ins short, call rollback quickly if any sustained regressions. Document every manual step taken (timestamps).

Scratchpad end.
